source: Actual seeded production-engine calibration, not student results or a supplied checkpoint.
protocol: Five independent trained agents per method. Same fixed reference map; five frozen episodes per agent. Zero interactions is an actual untrained baseline. Threshold is a guided small-map practice criterion, not comparable grading across arbitrary edited tasks.
